en.title: Separate Services, Shared Database: How You Build a Distributed Monolith
en.subtitle: When services read and write the same tables, the schema becomes a contract nobody owns, and releases have to be coordinated again. Give each service its own data.

ar-EG.title: لما الـ services تشارك نفس الـ database: كده بتبني distributed monolith
ar-EG.subtitle: لما الـ services تقرا وتكتب في نفس الـ tables، الـ schema بتبقى contract محدش مالكه، والـ releases بترجع لازم تتنسّق. ادّي كل service الداتا بتاعتها.
